input.question_for_claimant: Our records show the sold-at retailer for this product as Sears, but the claim lists Corner Hardware Co. Please confirm where the product was bought. If you have the receipt, please make sure it clearly shows the store name, the purchase date, and the model. If it was a Sears purchase, let us know. If the product was bought secondhand or as a gift, tell us that too, along with any other proof of ownership you have.
